'''Fleet ordnance''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was responsible for supplying weapons and ammunition to all [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and Navy units. Ordnance typically used secure vessels to transport cargo, but would resort to using [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessels]] if a large operation was organized without giving ordnance time to organize secure transport.
